name: Agent Authorisation Online
description: Technical guidance for software developers working with the Agent Authorisation Online service. This API is separate from the Making Tax Digital programme.

name: Alcohol and Tobacco Warehouse Declaration Online
description: Excise Warehouses are HMRC‑authorised premises that can receive and store goods liable for excise duty without paying the duty upfront. This API lets Excise Warehouses submit Excise Warehouse Returns (W1), Alcohol Remittance Warrants (W5), Alcohol Deferment Warrants (W5D), Tobacco Remittance Warrants (W6), and Tobacco Deferment Warrants (W6D).

name: Automatic Exchange of Information
description: Automatic exchange of information agreements allow the UK and other countries to share tax information to prevent tax avoidance. Banks and other financial institutions send HMRC details about their non‑UK customers, which HMRC can then share with overseas tax authorities.

name: Charities Online
description: An API that allows charities and Community Amateur Sports Clubs (CASCs) to submit, amend and get information on Gift Aid claims.

name: Construction Industry Scheme Online
description: Use this API to verify a subcontractor’s details and submit monthly CIS300 returns. Under the Construction Industry Scheme,  contractors must deduct tax and National Insurance from payments to subcontractors and send these deductions to HMRC.

name: Corporation Tax Online
description: An API that allows companies to submit or amend a corporation tax return (CT600).

name: EC Sales List Online
description: The XML ECSL Declaration Service lets VAT‑registered traders and their agents submit EC Sales Lists (ECSL) directly through commercial or bespoke software. Since Brexit, VAT‑registered businesses that supply goods from Northern Ireland to VAT‑registered customers in the EU must tell HMRC about those supplies.

name: Employment intermediaries
description: Employment intermediaries, data requirements for software developers.

name: Excise Movement Control System
description: Use this API to submit movement notices to the Excise Movement Control System (EMCS), view messages from EMCS and retrieve information about traders.

name: Exchange rates from HMRC
description: Check the foreign exchange monthly rates, yearly averages, spot rates and weekly amendments to rates (from HMRC in CSV and XML format).

name: Import Control System
description: Use this API to submit Entry Summary Declarations (ENS) to the Import Control System (ICS) for goods entering the EU or Northern Ireland. ICS carries out risk analysis before goods leave their country of departure. You can also use this API to get decisions on whether those goods are allowed to enter the EU or Northern Ireland.

name: New Computerised Transit System
description: Use this API to interact with the New Computerised Transit System (NCTS). It supports the electronic declaration and processing of Community and Common Transit movements

name: PAYE Online
description: Use this content to understand the technical specifications you need when working with the PAYE Online service.

name: Pension Schemes Online
description: Use this service to register as a pension scheme administrator or practitioner. Use it to file a scheme administrator’s declaration, submit event reports and complete accounting for tax returns.

name: Real Time Information online
description: Use this content to understand the technical specifications you need when working with the Real Time Information (RTI) online service.

name: Self Assessment Online
description: Use this API to submit Self Assessment tax returns for the old, pre‑MTD ITSA service. It supports individual, partnership, trust and estate returns.

name: Stamp Taxes Online
description: Use this service to submit a Stamp Duty Land Tax (SDLT) return (SDLT5) when a property is purchased. It lets you complete and file the return online so you can meet your legal obligations and ensure HMRC receives the correct stamp duty information for the transaction.
